mark: Each mark is a flat square of paint in a thick ink line with its own small hard shadow, the letters in black Archivo capitals; the round mark has a second frame stamped inside it, a picked mark gets a fat 4 px frame, and corner glyphs are square bolts.
stackbar: The bar is a rule printed in the ink line on its hard shadow, parts are flat paint divided by ink, the limit is an ink block standing out of the bar. Pointing at a part lifts it up-left while its shadow stays; the legend row under the pointer turns into the yellow plate.
bullets: Labels are bold capitals. A row you point at lifts up-left onto a hard shadow and turns yellow; a warning figure is yellow paint, a failing one red paint, each in an ink frame with its own small shadow.
tick: While a number counts it carries a yellow copy of itself 3 px down-right, like the headline slam; the yellow is struck off in one cut the moment the number lands.
uptime: The strip is square blocks of paint (green, yellow, red with the stripes) in a thin ink line. Pointing at a cell lifts it with a small hard shadow. Title and percentage are in Archivo, figures in the mono.
uptime-states: Loading is the lintel hoisted: one well along the whole strip with one beam on two cables lifted in hard steps, plus the busy card in the middle. Empty and failed keep the exact footprint; a failure is red paint in an ink frame.
uptime-phone: The same strip at phone width, one line per strip; the thin ink frames keep the cells apart and no text touches.
inbox: Each row says its state in a thick bar of paint on its start edge (ink for new, lavender for in flight, yellow for a warning, red-and-black hazard stripes for a failure); the next one up is the yellow slab in an ink frame. Done rows go quieter by ink.
backlog: The same rows for a backlog: ink rules between rows, bars of paint for state, bold titles, buttons that are brutalism's own.
files: File rows with the format in the lead column, ruled in ink; a failed file has the hazard stripes down its edge. Buttons lift and press like the theme's buttons.
appointments: The day is in Archivo capitals and the hour in mono; the next appointment is a yellow slab in a frame, past ones go quiet by ink.
checks: A check with a reservation is taped off: yellow-and-black hazard stripes along its foot, the mark in warning paint. A failed row keeps the red stripes; the written fix is bold.
sort: Nothing new is drawn: the table keeps brutalism's own heavy head and sort marks; a column that cannot be sorted now has no pointer and a quieter mark.
kv: Keys are small bold capitals, rows are separated by 2 px ink lines, a changed value is marked by a black block, and a row that could not be read is taped off with hazard stripes along its foot.
formrows: Labels are bold capitals. A row changed and not saved has a yellow bar in an ink frame on its start edge; a row in error has the red-and-black hazard stripes there. Rows are ruled in ink.
tiles: Choice tiles are slabs: a 3 px ink line on a hard shadow. Pointing lifts a tile up-left (its shadow stays on the ground), a press drives it onto its footprint, the picked tile is yellow. A disabled tile is dashed and has no shadow.
card-states: The card is a slab in all four states; the failure is taped off along its foot with hazard stripes, the data that returns is set down from up-left and stops dead, loading is the lintel in the busy card.
header: The page header's title is Archivo capitals, the freshness line in the mono; the mark, badge and line stay on one row without touching.
art: The drawings are slabs in heavy ink strokes: none is an empty slab on its footprint, nomatch the slab lifted off its footprint, error a slab taped off with red stripes, offline two slabs with a cut cable, done a slab with a stamped tick, locked a slab with a padlock and four square bolts. Each stroke is set down from up-left and stops dead.
pipeline: Lanes are slabs on their hard shadow with a head in the stage's flat paint and Archivo capitals; cards are small slabs, pointing lifts a card up-left and turns it yellow, the open card is yellow in a heavier frame, marks are square with a small shadow.
pipeline-states: Loading is the lintel in the busy card; an empty or failed board has its sentence on a slab, a failure taped off with hazard stripes, and the lanes keep their places.
journey: The journey is a path of blocks: an ink rule between reached steps, a dashed rule to what is to come, reached steps are filled blocks, the step it stands at is a yellow block lifted off its footprint on a bigger shadow.
journey-states: A closed journey ends in a red block and its rule turns into red-and-black hazard stripes. Loading and empty keep the footprint.
contact: Moments are square bolts with their own small shadow, planned ones hollow; a stretch in warning is hazard tape. Pointing at a bolt lifts it up-left.
contact-states: Empty and failed keep the room of the loaded line, the sentence on a plate; loading is the lintel with the busy card.
secret: The value sits in a slab well. When it is shown it is slammed onto its footprint from up-left with an ink offset that is struck off in one cut, and the time running out is a 6 px ink bar that gets shorter in ten hard steps.
secret-phone: The same field at phone width: buttons under the value, the counting line keeps its room, nothing touches.
manage: The dialog in sections is ruled with 3 px ink lines, headings are bold capitals, the danger section is taped off with hazard stripes along its foot, the dependants list is a small slab.
confirm: The confirmation lists what still uses the thing in a slab on a hard shadow; a blocked removal shows no field and says why.
type-dialog: The list of what will be lost is a slab taped off along its foot; the name to type is a yellow plate in an ink box; the match line is always there and bold.
type-own: The same typed block in a page's own dialog: identical parts, brutalism's own field.
type-phone: The typed confirmation at phone width: everything stacks, the hazard foot stays, nothing touches.
disc: The visual timer is a disc standing on its own hard shadow: a yellow sector, ink tick marks, a square black hub, the name in Archivo capitals.
disc-states: Paused turns the sector lavender. When the time is out the face turns yellow and is set down again from up-left, once.
disc-phone: Three discs at phone width: the face shrinks to fit, the name and line stay on one line each.
countdown: The countdown is a slab; every digit is a yellow block in an ink frame so the time reads like a printed board, in Archivo.
countdown-states: Paused turns the digits grey. When time is up the slab inverts (ink ground, paper digits) and is set down again from up-left once.
range: The preset chips are brutalism's segmented control; Custom is the yellow plate in a frame while open, the panel is the usual slab popover, the line under the bar is mono.
range-states: A wrong custom range has a thick red frame on the field and names the fault in a line that keeps its room.
wheel: A wheel of flat paint between ink lines in a heavy ink rim, capitals with a paper halo for reading, a yellow pointer in an ink outline and a round yellow hub on its own shadow. It turns at a constant speed and stops dead, no settling; the outcome is slammed in.
cook: Cook mode: each step is set down from up-left and stops dead; the text is bold, the counter and quantities are Archivo and mono, the ingredients are ruled off with a 3 px line.
timers: Timer cards are slabs with the time in Archivo. A timer that has run out is yellow paint with hazard stripes along its foot and is set down again from up-left when it arrives.
quantity: The number field is a slab with a hard shadow that lifts up-left while focused; the number is Archivo; the minus and plus are brutalism's own buttons.
checklist: Rows ruled in 2 px ink lines; the row under the pointer turns yellow; a ticked item is struck through with a thick ink line. Failed shows a slab taped off.
tri: Included is the yellow chip with a stamped tick in a square box; left out is an ink chip with a red box and a cross and the word struck through in paper. Pointing lifts the chip up-left.
code: The code block is a slab with a yellow head like the dialog's band; JSON keys are marked in lavender paint; a failed read is taped off along its foot.
command: A terminal slab: yellow head with the shell name in capitals, the code is paper on an ink ground and each prompt is yellow.
command-long: Long commands wrap or scroll inside the ink plate; continuation lines keep the prompt's width.
command-phone: The command at phone width: the head wraps, the code scrolls inside its plate, nothing touches the edge.
compare: The divider is a 6 px ink bar and the handle a yellow block in an ink frame with its own shadow, lifted off its footprint; labels are small slabs in capitals; a failed pane is taped off with a normal-size Retry.
compare-live: The live compare slider: dragging moves the bar and the block; panes keep their size while loading with the busy card over them.
